description: This Java source file defines a set of integration tests for the Device Registration HTTP endpoint within the Eclipse Hono project. The tests verify registration, retrieval, update, and deregistration functionality for devices via HTTP requests, using JUnit and Vert.x testing frameworks.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationHttpIT
classes.description: An integration test class for device registration HTTP endpoint, verifying create, read, update, and delete operations through HTTP requests, using JUnit 5, Vert.x, and related testing utilities.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the static DeviceRegistryHttpClient used by subsequent tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares a fresh deviceId UUID for each test.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Cleans up by deregistering the device after each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes Vert.x instance after all tests complete.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful registration of a device.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsWithoutDeviceId
methods.description: Tests registration when device ID is not supplied, expecting a generated location header.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsForDuplicateDevice
methods.description: Ensures duplicate device registration results in a conflict.

methods.name: testAddDeviceFailsForMissingContentType
methods.description: Checks that missing content type during registration yields a bad request.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Verifies registration with an empty body proceeds successfully.

methods.name: testAddDeviceSucceedsForEmptyBodyAndContentType
methods.description: Verifies registration with neither body nor content type succeeds.

methods.name: testGetDeviceContainsRegisteredInfo
methods.description: Checks that registered device info is correctly returned.

methods.name: testGetDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Ensures retrieval of info for a non-existing device fails appropriately.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies updating device info replaces the previous data.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks that updating a non-existent device fails with not found.

methods.name: testUpdateDeviceFailsForMissingContentType
methods.description: Ensures update request without content type results in a bad request.

methods.name: testDeregisterDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies device deregistration logs out the device.

methods.name: testDeregisterDeviceFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks that deregistering a non-existent device results in failure.
